_readme: Card shops around Rochester NY, and where you can actually sit down and
play. Drives /shops.html.
WHY BUYING AND PLAYING ARE ON ONE PAGE. Round here they are the same three
buildings. A shops page with two entries and a league page with two entries
is two thin pages; one page that answers both is worth reading.

THE ORDER OF THIS ARRAY IS THE ORDER OF THE CARDS ON THE PAGE, and it is deliberate rather than alphabetical or arbitrary. The owner, August 24, 2026: LingSter Games first, then Millennium Games, then the rest. Those are the two he actually deals with, and LingSter is the shop the rip log thanks by name for selling at MSRP. The map key below the map is a DIFFERENT order, west to east, because that one is about geography and is sorted in the builder; changing this array does not touch it.
Add a shop with a name and a url. Everything else is optional and simply
does not render when missing: area, address, phone, hours, blurb, goodFor,
and the whole play block.
HOURS ARE THE ONE EXCEPTION AND THE BUILD ENFORCES IT. A shop with `hours`
must also carry `hoursSrc`, the page on the shop's OWN site where those
hours are stated, and `hoursRead`, the day somebody read them there.
build-shops.mjs throws without them. This is the site's rule and not this
file's: /garbage-plate.html has enforced the same thing on restaurants since
it was written, for the reason written beside its own guard, that an hour
nobody can check is how somebody drives to a locked door.
Do NOT fill hoursSrc from Google, Yelp or any other directory. The point is
the business stating its own hours. If a shop publishes none, leave `hours`
off entirely rather than copying them from somewhere else.
URLS ARE CLEANED ON PURPOSE. A link copied out of a shop's own site often
carries tracking or session parameters (_su_rec, utm_, fbclid and friends).
Those point at one browsing session, they rot, and they hand a third party a
record of where the visitor came from. Link the plain page instead.
`visited` marks a shop that has appeared in a video. Set it when a rip is
filmed there so the page can say so.
PLAY TIMES ARE NOT PUBLISHED UNLESS THEY ARE CONFIRMED. League nights move,
get canceled, and go quiet over the summer. Where a store's official Play!
Pokemon league page and a secondhand listing disagree, the page says they
disagree and sends you to the shop, because the cost of being wrong here is
somebody driving across town to a dark room.
ROCHESTER NY ONLY, and its ring. A national search for 'Rochester Pokemon
league' returns Rochester MINNESOTA and Rochester MICHIGAN above ours, and
both of those were nearly listed here. Check the zip: ours are 146xx.
That trap is live, not historical. On August 15, 2026 a search for Rochester
Pokemon leagues returned a 'Rochester Sports Cards And Memorabilia League'
(407 S Main St, Rochester MICHIGAN) and a 'Rochester Pokemon League' at
NerdinOut (1802 2nd St SW, Rochester MINNESOTA). Both look local until you
read the zip.
WHERE EACH ENTRY CAME FROM, and when it was read. Every fact below was taken
from the business stating it about itself, not from a directory. Read
August 15, 2026 unless noted:
Just Games        justgamesrochester.com/category/pokemon/ states the
address, phone and the Mon-Sat noon-9, Sun noon-6 hours.
Millennium Games  shop.millenniumgames.com footer states the address,
phone and the hours added on this pass.
LingSter Games    lingstergames.com/shop states the address, phone and
hours. See the move note below.
Legacy Games      legacygamestore.com states address, phone and hours;
singles.legacygamestore.com lists priced Pokemon singles
under the same name and address.
Great Lakes       glgaminglounges.com/pokemon prices packs, ETBs and
booster boxes; /tcg states Wooper Wednesday at 6:30pm.
WeTheHobby        wethehobby.com/pages/contact states address, phone and
hours; /pages/events lists a Pokemon Weekly League on
every Thursday of the current month.
ONE SHOP PUBLISHES HOURS WE DELIBERATELY DO NOT CARRY, and it was two until
August 26, 2026. Great Lakes Gaming HAS hours here now: their own /calendar
page carries them as plain text, which is the business stating its own hours
and clears the rule. THE TRAP ATTACHED TO THEM: every page of that Squarespace
site also emits theme boilerplate reading 'openingHours':'Mo 09:00-21:00 ... Su
09:00-21:00' and a businessHours JSON of 9am-9pm daily. That directly
contradicts the visible block, which says Monday and Tuesday CLOSED. It is a
template default and not the business, so do not scrape it. The old reason
still stands for the Instagram caption on their home page, which is stale and
still advertises events 'Coming January 2026'. WeTheHobby's
own contact page reads 'SAT 11pm to 8pm', which is impossible; 11am is what
is recorded here. Prefer omitting an hour to inventing one.
LINGSTER MOVED, and the old address is still all over the internet. Their
own blog has a September 2025 post opening a brick and mortar at 4675 West
Ridge Road, Spencerport 14559, then a June 2026 post opening the current
shop at 1586 West Ridge Road, Rochester 14615. Aggregators mix the two, and
the Spencerport hours (Mon/Wed/Fri 2-7pm) still surface first. The address
and hours in this file are the ones on lingstergames.com/shop today.
SHOPS CHECKED AND LEFT OUT, so nobody re-researches them: Yankee Clipper
House of Cards, Comics Etc, Boldo's Armory, Endzone Collectibles / In The
Zone, Game On, Hammergirl Anime, All Heroes Comics, Rochester CCG, Flower
City Cards, PokeSalesByRoc, Hobby House Toys. Each failed on one of: its own
site never says it sells Pokemon, it has no storefront, or its address is
reported two different ways with nothing from the business to settle it.
Directory sites are not evidence: tcglist.org tags all 23 of its Rochester
listings with the identical 'Magic, Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh' trio, including a
playing card manufacturer and a craft store.
playNote: Play! Pokemon league schedules change constantly and go quiet between seasons. Call the shop before you drive.

shops.name: LingSter Games
shops.hours: Wed to Sat 11am to 9:30pm, Sun 11am to 6pm, closed Mon and Tue
shops.blurb: Deep Pokemon singles and sealed, and the first stop when a set drops.
shops.youtubeNote: Added 27 August 2026. The channel the owner credits by name in five of his own rip descriptions. youtube.com/@LingSterGames answers 200 and its page reads "LingSter Games", unboxings and Twitch VODs, so it is the shop and not a name collision. It is also the join that puts their mark on those five rip pages.
shops.logoNote: Sent by the shop for this use, August 24, 2026.

shops.name: Millennium Games
shops.address: 1225 Jefferson Road, Suite A17, Rochester, NY 14623
shops.hours: Mon to Sat 10am to 10pm, Sun 10am to 6pm
shops.blurb: One of the biggest game stores in the area, with a Pokemon section to match and a sanctioned league of its own.
plays: Trade days, about once a quarter
shops.playNote: Straight from the store, by email on August 27, 2026: league nights every Monday at 6pm, and trade days roughly once a quarter with no fixed schedule. Their Delta Reign prerelease is penciled in for October 25 and is not locked yet; it goes on their own calendar once it is. Their Play! Pokemon league page still reads Inactive, which is their listing being stale rather than the league being off.

shops.name: Just Games
shops.hours: Mon to Sat noon to 9pm, Sun noon to 6pm
shops.blurb: Rochester's flagship game store, and the biggest of these. Singles, sealed and a proper events room. Through 2025 it had the busiest Pokemon calendar in the area; that calendar has gone quiet, so read the note below before you plan a trip around it.
shops.playNote: Their Pokemon events have gone quiet, and it is their own three sources that say so, all read August 26, 2026. The Pokemon page this listing used to link has not been posted to since December 3, 2025 and carries nothing from 2026. Their live events calendar, covering late August to mid October 2026, lists no Pokemon at all: Magic, Lorcana, Star Wars Unlimited, 40K, D&D and Dice Throne, and no Pokemon. And their Play! Pokemon league reads Inactive. They ran prereleases, League Challenges and Cups, a Gym Leader Challenge season and Learn to Play sessions right through 2025, so this may be a gap rather than an ending. Call the counter before you drive out.

shops.name: Legacy Games
shops.hours: Mon to Sat 11am to 9:30pm, Sun noon to 7pm
shops.blurb: The Webster one, and the furthest east of these. They run a separate singles storefront alongside the main site, so you can see which Pokemon singles are actually in the case before you make the drive. They buy cards too.
plays: Release events for new Pokemon sets
Learn to play events, held regularly
shops.playNote: The Monday casual play, the release events and the learn to play sessions come from the store directly, by email on August 27, 2026. The Tuesday league is from their own event pages: $5 to enter and it comes back as store credit, with a Pokemon prize pack on entry. Their calendar only publishes about two weeks ahead, so it shows one Tuesday at a time rather than a weekly series.

shops.name: Great Lakes Gaming
shops.address: 100 S Clinton Ave, Suite 22, Rochester, NY 14604
shops.hours: Wed, Thu and Sun 5pm to 10pm, Fri and Sat 5pm to midnight. Closed Mon and Tue.
shops.blurb: Not a shop front. It is a gaming lounge on the 22nd floor of an office tower downtown that sells Pokemon packs, Elite Trainer Boxes and booster boxes at the counter and gives Wednesday night over to Pokemon.
plays: Trading card game and video game, plus Pokemon Go and Unite
shops.playNote: The Wednesday time is off their own trading card games page. Being on the 22nd floor, it is an elevator and a parking garage rather than a door off the street, so leave a few extra minutes.

shops.name: WeTheHobby
shops.area: Arlington Street, Neighborhood of the Arts
shops.hours: Mon to Wed noon to 6pm, Thu and Fri noon to 8pm, Sat 11am to 8pm, Sun 11am to 6pm
shops.blurb: Mostly sports cards, and better known for breaking live online than for a Pokemon singles case. The Arlington Street building is a real shop and lounge you can walk into though, and there is a Pokemon league in it every week.
shops.playNote: Their own events calendar carries the league on every Thursday of the current month, but does not publish a start time. Check the calendar or ask when you walk in.

shops.name: GI Cards and Collectibles
shops.blurb: A Geneva card shop that also runs the Sports Cards and Collectibles Show at del Lago, which is where most people around here will meet them. Their own store is heaviest on Magic and sealed sports, and their shows are billed as Pokemon, Magic and One Piece as well.
shops.linksNote: Every one of these was resolved from the tr.ee short links the owner was sent, which land on a Linktree interstitial rather than on the destination: following one gave linktr.ee/gicards, and that page holds the real urls. Two were then confirmed against the platform itself rather than trusted: youtube.com/channel/UClGgD1iucbm5HgB0MKSZTZw reports its handle as @gicards and its title as GI Cards and Collectibles, and whatnot.com/user/gicards is a 3.4K follower profile that links the same Linktree back. THE FACEBOOK ONE IS A GROUP, not a page, which is why the handle reads groups/gicards. THEIR TIKTOK IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT: the only link they publish for it is vm.tiktok.com/ZM8n9NbjP, which now lands on TikTok's home page rather than on a profile, and tiktok.com answers 200 for any handle at all, so guessing one could not be checked. Their link is broken, not our lookup.
shops.gap: NO ADDRESS, NO PHONE AND NO HOURS, and that is what could be found rather than what was looked for. Their Shopify store publishes none of the three, they have no OpenStreetMap record, and the site's rule is that hours go up only where the business states them about itself. The number on their show flyer, 315.620.5360, is Gary's line for reserving tables at the show and is not published as the shop's, so it is not used here. The owner is at their show on 29 August and can ask.

_geocoded.note: `at` is [lat, lon] for the shop's own street address, geocoded once by hand and stored so no build touches the network. Every result was checked to be the same street and number as the `address` field above it before it was written here. Suite numbers are stripped before geocoding: Nominatim has no node for 'Suite 34' and returns nothing at all for the whole address rather than falling back to the building, which is why four of the six looked unlocatable at first. A shop with no `at` is left off the map and keeps its card, rather than being placed approximately.
